parts.text: I plan and run flights using this service as a licensed dispatcher, and I am legally responsible for deciding which drone flies along which way and signing off a flight before it leaves. I can call off a flight, and I want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, though our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, while dealing with things happening outside our control like loads being ready or not, drone arrivals, and changing airspace closures that can come into force while drones are already in the air.
